definition: The record holds this date or this placement only loosely, so it is drawn with a dashed outline. It says how firmly the corpus knows something; it is not a verdict on a house and not a rule left unrun.
basis: workbench/app/src/theme/tokens.css, the duty block's comment on this mark: "Low confidence: a dashed outline, for a date or a placement the record holds only loosely." It stands among "The marks that are not a verdict, and so never borrow a verdict's form", and the block states the rule every mark keeps: "Each duty token below means one thing wherever it is drawn".
